# Vendored code

`foliate-js/` is a trimmed copy of [johnfactotum/foliate-js](https://github.com/johnfactotum/foliate-js)
at commit `78914aef4466eb960965702401634c2cb348e9b1` (MIT, see `foliate-js/LICENSE`).
The PDF, OPDS and dictionary modules and the demo reader page were removed;
nothing else is modified.

It bundles [zip.js](https://github.com/gildas-lormeau/zip.js) (BSD-3-Clause) and
[fflate](https://github.com/101arrowz/fflate) (MIT) under `foliate-js/vendor/`.
